name: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
summary: Counterfactual world models that predict alternative outcomes from observed trajectories under the same environmental randomness enable a policy gradient estimator using counterfactual returns as baselines, improving policy learning when environmental dynamics are harder to predict than action effects.
